title: feat(objectql, core, metadata)!: tool names held per namespace, and the metadata service keeps each package's tool in its own (package, name) slot (ADR-0150 child B)
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DSL8MNE2jk3FnZEq9DvJJo1)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：工具（tool）的同名规则从「整个部署只能一个包持有」放宽为「每个命名空间一个」，与 agent、skill、action、邮件模板、flow、picklist 一族、webhook 一致；元数据服务把 tool 按（包，名字）分槽存。本轮在原 PR 基础上合入最新 main，补了一组「无包行 + 两个持有包」的钉子测试，并把升级说明登记成正式的迁移条目。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 第 14 张 B 卡。专题红线复读（6840825374）给了 HOLD：要求合 main、改两处说法、ADR-0087 不能再写「无需登记」、补一个 tool 的密封类型钉子；本 PR 逐条完成。
- 风险与回滚：BREAKING 只在进程内元数据服务的五个答案（两包同名的 tool 不带包名读取、删除、历史/比较/回滚由「最后一个」改为 409 点名两包），本仓第一方调用方 0；HTTP 与 MCP 门不变。同命名空间共有者、无命名空间包、base/system/sys、内置名照旧被拒。回滚就是把 `tool` 从两个集合里删掉。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts` 与 `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`（两个集合各加 `tool`，与 webhook 并存）、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.tool-names-per-namespace.ts`（新登记的升级条目）、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts` 末尾新钉子。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t tool`，应 12 条全部通过（其中 8 条是新加的 tool：两种注册顺序 × 四种回填状态）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #31985
Supersedes #32895

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — widened: the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), its item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) and the cold boot's holder seal (`SchemaRegistry.sealBareNameHolders`) accept, for a tool, a second package holder from another declared namespace. Narrowed: `tool` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`, so five in-process answers of the metadata service for a tool move from served to refused or empty (rows 5–9 below); first-party callers in this repo 0.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #32916 (owed: `content/docs/ai/tools.mdx` and the spec jsdoc still call a tool name globally unique) — otherwise `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no tool rename on a cross-namespace clash, no in-process `get('tool', …)`, no tool history read and no `/layers?package=` read of a tool.

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers in this repo **0**: no production source calls `get`, `getDiagnosed`, `unregister`, `getHistory`, `diff` or `rollback` with the type `tool`; first-party tool records in `examples/`: 0; on a booted stack no HTTP or MCP door moves from served to refused. The cloud's calls on the metadata service for type `tool` are listed in the cloud reading 6837767385 and carried to the cloud separately (Carried to repo:cloud).

> **Draft condition (epic read 6760270915): met, limb (b)**, per the epic ruling 6838039881 on the cloud reading 6837767385 (cloud `main@9b50c62e`): no cloud reader reads a package `tool` record. `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` names cloud `9b50c62e`, the reading and the ruling, and keeps the rule for the first cloud reader: resolve by the referrer's own `(package, name)`, refuse two holders `409` naming every candidate, never the first registered.
>
> **Branch.** This thread cannot push `claude/project-thread-cb6zil`, so this is a new draft from `claude/project-thread-w47m4s`, which continues `cb6zil@d39ba1312` (every commit kept, never rebased) with `origin/main` merged once. `#32895` is superseded; the seat retires it.

Still refused, each with today's envelope and sentence: a co-owner of the holder's namespace (for a tool that is the namespace co-owner rule's `NamespaceNameConflictError`, child N, which judges a tool ahead of this rule at every install, boot included), a package with no namespace beside any holder (a disabled one included), two packages of one shareable namespace (`base`, `system`, `sys`), and a built-in name.

## Red lines

1. **Resolution is never loosened.** No reader in this repo resolves a `skill.tools[]` entry from a `tool` record. The one by-name reader of a record, `/meta/tool/NAME`, keeps ADR-0150 D3's order, pinned by child E8's `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` (`tool` in `E8_TYPES`; green at this head, below). Since the last head, `main` added one in-repo reader of `skill.tools[]` (#32880, `skillBindingServed` in `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts`): it matches each entry against the MCP connection's live served tool names, never a `tool` record, so it reaches no package holder.
2. **Ambiguity is reported, never guessed.** Two served holders of a tool name answer `409` naming both at the bare read, the bare `/layers` and `/published` (both transports) and at the metadata service (rows 5, 7, 8, 9, 16). A package-less row beside two holders is declined at each exact address, so neither holder's address serves it (ruling 3 pins). Two by-order paths remain, both older than this PR and both reached by every narrowed type: the in-process layered read with no service copy (#32914), and two stored rows each naming a holder of one name, where the hydration keeps the last loaded (the second case #32692 names for a webhook; the widening is #33127, ruling 5).
3. **Independently releasable.** Clause-② arms above and in the changeset, every moved answer in the table, `Metadata-protocol: added`, the ADR-0087 registration, and pins that go red under ablation (Tests).

## ADR-0087

`adr-0087: registered tool-names-per-namespace`. The semantic entry records the five in-process answers (row 5–9), the remedy (pass the package; `?package=` or the qualified address over REST), and the row binding a legacy loader row needs (`migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages`, re-runnable, or the package's next save). No key is added, removed or re-shaped, so no D2 conversion and no tombstone. Its own changeset `.changeset/31985-tool-names-semantic-entry.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`) is the picklist family's shape (#32513).

## Readings (a)–(d), re-measured on this head

- **(a) Face (D6).** No surface in this repo shows a package `tool` record to a model or an MCP client. 336 non-test source files changed between `f770d664` and `origin/main`; none adds a reader of a `tool` record (the one new `tools` reader is #32880's, under red line 1).
- **(b) Caller references (D3).** `agent.tools` was removed in spec 17; a skill's `tools[]` is resolved by the cloud runtime, and in this repo only matched against the MCP connection's served tool names (#32880). The "Used by" panel (`findReferencesToMeta`) matches by bare name: over-inclusive, never a missed reference.
- **(c) Stored references.** D8 has no `tool` row; S4's report holds 0 `tool` rows. First-party tool records in `examples/`: 0.
- **(d) Built-in names.** `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` holds `permission` and `email_template` only: tool census **0**.

## Carried to repo:cloud

Once tool records stop being inert, or any cloud change first reads a package `tool` record: that reader **must** resolve a name from the referring item's own package (its own record, else the unique holder in its declared dependency closure, ADR-0150 D3), **must** refuse a name two packages hold, naming every candidate, and must never take the first one registered, never reach a tool outside that closure, and never reach a tool only the environment holds. The same obligation is in `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json`.

Also carried: the cloud reading 6837767385 lists three cloud calls on the metadata service for type `tool` by bare name with no package (a fixed-name existence probe, and AI Studio's register and retract of its built-in tool mirror). A bare removal of a name two packages hold is now refused `409`, so the mirror's retract can be refused where two namespaces each ship a tool named after a built-in; the refusal fails closed and picks no holder.

## Tests

Added this round:

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: `tool` joins #32741's location-4 loop: two holders × both registration orders × four states (stored, after the read-side hydrator, bare-slot copy stamped `''`, stamped `sys_metadata`): each exact address serves its own, the layered read reports `overlay: null`, the first holder's slot keeps its own; and one holder, before and after the hydrator.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts`: `[#31985] a package-less tool row saved before two namespaces' packages install the name…`: booted showcase, `PUT /meta/tool/NAME` for two names, then install-local of `kappa` (first name), `lambda` (both) and `iota` (second name), so one name is installed in id order and the other in reverse; each exact address, plain and `/layers?package=`, serves its own with `overlay: null`, before and after `GET /meta/tool` (the read-side hydrator); the bare read refuses `409` naming both. The artifact-door `/layers?package=` pin's title and the file header no longer claim a tool was served the last-registered package before (delta D3).

Ablation (sealed-type rule, ruling 3), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `ProtocolWriteGatesFacet.isSealedManagedItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-gates.ts`) made to answer `false` for `tool` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `b9477b0c` → `d8e19aaf`), metadata-protocol rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 2 built files:

- `objectql vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t tool` → **9 failed**, 3 passed (every new `tool` location-4 case: 8 two-holder cells and the one-holder case).
- dogfood `test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts` → **1 failed** (the new pin: `expected 409 to be 200` at an exact address), 26 passed.
- Restored: blob after restore `b9477b0c` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight: marker absent from all 24 built files, tree clean.

The earlier ablations of the two set memberships (predicate: 9 red; store: 1 + 7 red; store under the HTTP layered doors: green, row 12) ran on `cb6zil` and are not repeated: the merge changed neither set's `tool` entry, and the epic read re-ran them (its table).

## Acceptance notes

- `NAMESPACE_UNIQUE_TYPES` (child N) still lists `tool`, so a tool's same-namespace co-owner is refused by N's sentence; the tool matrix's rival is a package with no namespace.
- **The package-less row beside a package tool (was "not measured here").** Measured at this head: a package-less tool row saved before two namespaces' packages install the name is declined at each holder's exact address, plain and layered (`overlay: null`), before and after the read-side hydrator, in both install orders, and the bare read refuses `409` naming both (the new dogfood pin; the unit pin adds the bare-slot copies). Where AI Studio mounts, its built-in mirror holds such rows (cloud reading 6837767385): a package tool of one of those names is refused at install beside it (the no-namespace pairing, unchanged); two namespaces' tools of such a name would be read as above.
- **Carried, by order (red line 2).** (i) The boot hydration: since #32741 it grafts no package-less tool row onto a holder's slot; two stored rows each naming a holder of one name still leave only the last loaded (measured by the epic read on its scratch merge; the second case #32692 names for a webhook; the widening is #33127, ruling 5). (ii) The protocol's in-process layered read with a bare name and no service copy answers the first-registered holder (#32914); both HTTP transports refuse it `409` first.
- The fixture's sealed clash rides on `connector`, the last covered type not narrowed.
- The platform-provided tool names are not built-ins here; a later change that makes package tool records reach the AI service's registry owns that clash.
